"I am afraid he’s going to kill me if I walk out the door, I’m afraid he’s going to take my kids, close all the bank accounts, I’m afraid that he’ll find me later and shoot me." #DV

A #DV #MeToo style movement could help debunk common myths about domestic abuse, as well as pressure the criminal and legal systems to make things easier for the victims, not the abusers, advocates say. https://t.co/D6ReyNlk2l via @usatoday

@MichelleBarish @ktumulty You will be defined by your courage in the face of intimidation and the usual societal stereotyping. Those of us who've been there understand the Jekyll/Hyde dynamic all too well. #MeToo #TimesUp #DV
There's a Rape Problem at Music Festivals and Nobody Seems to Care (Also conventions of all kinds, anywhere people gather...) https://t.co/bG9CHGZf4A via @broadly #MeToo #TimesUp
#1110: "Dudebro won't stop bugging me about another dudebro. I JUST WANNA DO MY JOB." #MeToo https://t.co/t162GQpUgJ via @wordpressdotcom

"Emotional abuse is a very common thing. More common than you’d think." https://t.co/8am4eKDVet #MeToo It took me far longer to get over the emotional abuse than to recover from physical abuse. Kudos to Chloe Dykstra for breaking free and recovering.

Emotional abuse is every bit as destructive as physical abuse. Many of us who've experienced both found that it took longer to recover from emotional abuse--even when the physical abuse was life threatening and horrific. #MeToo #TimesUp
I'd like to recommend: The Verbally Abusive Relationship, Expanded Third Edition: How to recognize it and how to respond. https://t.co/y1RoP9yNqG via @amazon Re: emotional abuse #MeToo
WILL CHRONIC-ILLNESS PATIENTS GET THEIR #METOO MOVEMENT? https://t.co/W6hQJbFlp5

In any event, when evaluating #MeToo accounts it's not necessarily proof of anything when an ex comes forward to say "not with me!"

I could speculate about why I got the physical abuse; it might be my being a teen with low self esteem who didn't push back on boundary violations.
@thedailybeast Nor does it equal being blacklisted by powerful Hollywood moguls or others as in #MeToo

Those of us who've had a chance to know abusers with many sides to their personalities understand this--it's hard to fathom unless you've personally seen them at their worst. Even people who support #MeToo and #TimesUp can have trouble believing someone they love harms others.
When former members of these groups or "families" speak out I hope we will listen. #MeToo #TimesUp

Bishop apologizes to Ariana Grande for "awkward touch" while he was hugging her. Plausible deniability. Maybe abandon this tradition of hugging young women and this won't happen. #MeToo #RespectAriana https://t.co/i71BR4mSHC via @detroitnews

People will accuse you of doing it for the money but there is no money and in fact you'll be borrowing money to pay extra housing costs when you flee your home. But sure, you want money. And fame. So you can be threatened and insulted continuously. #MeToo
